name: Solanaceae: After All
source:
Solanaceae: After All is a hybrid visual novel, point-and-click, with light gathering and crafting elements and management elements!

Join Battam, a witch exiled by all conventional covens, on his quest to make a brand new type of coven with the help of his partner Sal, and his sibling, Satine.

Explore a colorful world filled with all types of people and try to create a place where any and all rejected witches can join together to create and love.

Learn more about Battam's sibling Satine (and watch them repair their shaky relationship), meet new people that challenge Battam's beliefs, and discover new ways the magic interacts with with the world-- all while fighting back against the overbearing Rowan Coven who is trying to stop Battam!

[From [url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/solanaceae-vn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Solanaceae: After All》融合了视觉小说与点击冒险玩法，并带有轻量的采集、制作及经营要素！

巴塔姆是一名遭所有传统巫师结社放逐的巫师。与他一起，在伴侣萨尔及手足萨汀的帮助下，努力建立一种全新的结社。

探索一个色彩缤纷、生活着各式各样居民的世界，尝试创造一个地方，让所有遭到排斥的巫师都能在此相聚，共同创作、共同相爱。

更深入地了解巴塔姆的手足萨汀，见证两人修复摇摇欲坠的关系。结识挑战巴塔姆信念的新朋友，发现魔法与世界相互作用的全新方式。同时，还得对抗蛮横的花楸结社，他们正试图阻止巴塔姆！

[摘自[url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/solanaceae-vn]itch.io[/url]]
